summary: Add multi-criteria workspace cleanup standard for non-LLM and LLM-assisted heuristics

delivery.outcome: Define closed multi-criteria workspace cleanup schema and dependency-free Python 3.12 stdlib evaluator supporting deterministic non-LLM scoring/hard-veto protection and bounded LLM-assisted heuristic advice validation, wired into conformance and documented under wellmanifest/docs.
nonGoals: Perform filesystem mutations or execute cleanup deletions from the standard module
Modify pinned git-lifecycle JSON Schemas, GBNF grammar, or .lifecycle profiles

architecture.decision: Reuse shared descriptor-safe JSON loading and RFC 3339/owner-repo primitives from standard/git_primitives.py while isolating cleanup contracts in standard/workspace-cleanup-policy.schema.json and standard/workspace_cleanup.py (< 500 lines, zero third-party deps).
interfaceChanges: Add workspaceCleanup self-test section to standard/conformance.py output
architecture.rollback: Revert standard/conformance.py, docs/README.md, and remove standard/workspace* and docs/information/workspace-cleanup-standard.md.
